what: Evidence for the audit of P. Anand's 'Zeta 7 is Irrational' (Zenodo 22920911 v1) and of issue #1 on gmDevi/zeta-7-21-lean. Fetched 2026-10-05 from public pages; nothing was posted, commented or sent.
rule: Every source is pinned by sha256 here and re-hashed by instruments/zeta7audit/battery.py. The paper is CC-BY-4.0 and is committed; Fauzan's paper carries no licence and the Lean repository is a third-party tree, so both live in the git-ignored corpus/sources/zeta7-anand/.cache/ — the battery re-hashes them when present and says so when they are not.

every issue on the repository (state=all): only #1
